I couldn't find a named night-dispatch contact for Driftmoor Marine Freight in what I can see. The notes mention a manual CSV patch for "the night dispatcher" but don't name them. The only night dispatcher I found by name is Hector, at Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which is a different account, so I'd not send the Driftmoor patch to him.

Kwame is the owner of the Driftmoor account and the best person to ask. I can post a question for him in #coastal-team if you want, or you can ask him directly.
